description: This file declares the AttachSamples class, which is a task for attaching media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes class definitions, data structures for audio and video data, and references to external media pipeline and GStreamer components.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class representing a task to attach media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline, encapsulating the data and execution logic.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with context, player, and media segments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to attach media samples to the pipeline.
